name: blender
description: Blender's node trees, Geometry Nodes, shaders and the compositor: a catalog per version of Blender in blender/<x.y>.json, written from what that Blender reports. `promised` lists the versions a text that says `blender` fits; `lts` the versions Blender names LTS; `variants` the files of blender/ that narrow it to what one consumer accepts
